t: Durable Forge Steel wooden mitre box ensures stability for accurate saw guidance, enabling precise, guided cuts in timber. Constructed from durable wood, it features preset cutting angles for both 45° and 90°, enabling reliable mitre and straight cuts for various applications. Ideal for carpenters, joiners, and DIY enthusiasts undertaking framing, skirting, or architrave work where consistent angles are crucial. The 300mm length and 93mm width allow the mitre box to accommodate common wood stock. Designed to handlle a maximum cut depth of 40mm and width of 57mm. Suitable for use with most back saws and hand saws.
